newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TV Azteca says '96 sales 1.2 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TV Azteca says '96 sales 1.2 bln pesos.

text.p: TV Azteca boss Ricardo Salinas Pliego estimated the firm's 1996 advertising revenue at 1.2 billion pesos, a spokesman for the company said on Thursday.
"Salinas said in his talk (to Monterrey accountants) that TV Azteca's advertising revenues would total 1.2 billion pesos by year's end," the spokesman said.
Salinas also said TV Azteca had invested $50 million to produce programs in house.
"We are investing heavily in entertainment programs, such as soap operas, where most investment goes, almost $40 million, and $10 million on general interest programs," the spokesman added.
